subject: Request: short sandbox runway after SSO connector delay
messages:
From: Samantha Lopez <slopez@brightfine.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Short runway request — SSO connector blocker

Hi Logan,

Quick note from our side: we kicked off the Redwood POC last week and things were going smoothly until our identity team hit an SSO edge-case with the SAML assertion the connector sends. That surfaced yesterday and has blocked our engineer from completing the end-to-end test suite.

We have a hard internal milestone on Oct 1 to present a prototype to the security committee; the current blocker will push us at least 10 business days. Given that, would Redwood be able to provide a two-week sandbox/top-up of credits so we don’t run out while our engineering team sorts the SSO fix? If you need logs I attached the connector_error_log.txt and a short integration_plan.xlsx with timelines.

We really like the performance characteristics so far and want to keep momentum. If there’s a form you need or additional info, tell me and I’ll get it over.

Thanks,
Samantha Lopez
Director, Platform Engineering | BrightFine
Samantha.Lopez@brightfine.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the clear summary and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear the SSO edge-case cropped up. Two quick asks so we can move this to an approval path:

1) Can you confirm the estimated go-live/committee demo date you mentioned (Oct 1)?
2) If you haven’t already, can you paste the exact failing assertion snippet (or the top 5 error lines) inline in your reply; sometimes the fix is a quick mapping change.

I’ve looped in Marissa (CSM) to own the credit side and Ben (sales director) for approval. From a commercial perspective we typically approve short sandbox top-ups for engineering delays — I’ll flag this as time-sensitive and keep it to a two-week runway unless Ben instructs otherwise.

If you’d like, we can also set a short 20-minute triage call tomorrow with one of our infra engineers to accelerate that SSO fix.

Best,
